project_info.scope: Dashboard and Shared Header/Navigation first-pass redesign

user_choices_and_requirements: Change app name from Kinetic Ledger to 'Records by Arsonist'
Remove 'dashboard' subtitle from the top header
Remove the top-right month selector / date badge beside the profile button in the Header
Change 'TOTAL MANAGED ASSETS & NET WORTH' label to 'NET WORTH'
Ensure the date in the Net Worth hero card is on the same line
Update chart timeframe date labels from 'D 1-5' and 'D 26-30' to 'Sep 1' and 'Sep 30'
Change 'allocated accounts & ledgers' section header to 'allocated liquidity'
Implement Space Grotesk font and Google Stitch Dark Neo-Brutalist aesthetic
Preserve all working functionality (real financial Context data, 7D/30D chart calculations, transactions stream filter, account ledgers)

typography.headings: Space Grotesk, bold/semibold, tight letter-spacing (-0.02em to -0.04em)
typography.numerical_readouts: tabular-nums / font-mono, Space Grotesk for alignment

changes: Brand section: Display 'RECORDS BY ARSONIST' with ⚡ minimal icon.
Remove 'DASHBOARD' / tab subtitle under the title.
Remove top-right calendar month dropdown selector.
Retain PWAInstallButton and user profile avatar button.
Hero Card: Header line with Wallet icon + 'NET WORTH' on left and single-line date range (e.g. 'Sep 1 - Sep 30') on the right.
Net Worth Amount: High contrast Space Grotesk formatted display value.
Actions: 'Add Transaction' and 'View Budgets' primary/secondary buttons.
Cash Flow Engine: 7D/30D velocity dynamics chart with interactive SVG wave, showing 'Sep 1' at start and 'Sep 30' at end.
Allocated Liquidity Section: Rename section title from 'Allocated Accounts & Ledgers' to 'Allocated Liquidity', horizontal swipe card deck for Bank & Card ledgers.
Burn Rate Progress Meter: Current Spend vs Monthly Envelope bar.
Recent Stream: Transaction stream with filters (all/income/work/personal) and explicit +/- debit/credit indicators.
Dark Neo-Brutalist sticky bottom bar (`bg-[#0b0e14]/95 border-t border-[#2a334a]`).
Active tab highlight in Electric Lime `#c3f400` with tactile shadow.

instructions_to_main_agent: Apply all style, branding, and text modifications directly to /app/frontend/src/components/Header.tsx, /app/frontend/src/components/DashboardView.tsx, and /app/frontend/src/components/BottomNav.tsx.
Verify font Space Grotesk is imported in index.html or index.css.
Do NOT insert fake or static sample data into the finance context; rely on useFinance() hook data.
Ensure all data-testid attributes listed in testing_attributes are attached to their respective elements.
